name: Max Speed 🏁UPDATE!
desc:
Work your way up to the best racer of all time!

════ UPDATE 42 ════
🚗 Introducing a new vehicle that can be purchased with Trophies.

Max Speed is a simplistic racing game for you to experience and dominate the speed!

💨 Click to pump up the tires for faster speed
🏆 Race to get trophies for eggs
🥚 Hatch eggs for various boosters
🏎️ Stay in the game to unlock new vehicles
🚩 Climb leaderboards and show who's the best driver!

⭐ Favorite & thumb up if you like the game!

Tags: Colorful, Super, Speed, Fun, Obby, Parkour, Race, Run, Victory, Win, Faster, Platformer, Clicker
